_readme: Licence-audited music beds. The pipeline never downloads audio: it reads this file, picks the first track whose mood matches, converts it to 24 kHz mono WAV and loops it under the narration. With no matching track it synthesises a labelled placeholder so generation still works. Only add tracks whose licence permits redistribution inside generated videos — CC0 preferred, CC-BY acceptable if assets/audio/ATTRIBUTION.md records the credit that the lesson end card must show. Verify the licence page on the download date and record it below; never add a track you have not checked.

_schema.file: path relative to the repository root
_schema.title: human readable title
_schema.bpm: whole number, used to place transition sounds on the beat
_schema.beatOffsetSeconds: seconds from file start to the first downbeat
_schema.licence: SPDX-ish label, e.g. CC0-1.0 or CC-BY-4.0
_schema.sourceUrl: page the track was obtained from
_schema.verifiedAt: YYYY-MM-DD when the licence page was checked
_schema.attribution: exact credit line required by the licence, or empty for CC0
_schema.sha256: sha256 of the file, so a swapped file is detected
